title: Sharp Testable Implications of Encouragement Designs
abstract: arXiv:2411.09808v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies a potential outcome model with a continuous or discrete outcome, a discrete multi-valued treatment, and a discrete multi-valued instrument. We derive sharp, closed-form testable implications for a class of restrictions on potential treatments where each value of the instrument encourages towards at most one unique treatment choice; such restrictions serve as the key identifying assumption in several prominent recent empirical papers. Borrowing the terminology used in randomized experiments, we call such a setting an encouragement design. The testable implications are inequalities in terms of the conditional distributions of choices and the outcome given the instrument. Through a novel constructive argument, we show these inequalities are sharp in the sense that any distribution of the observed data that satisfies these inequalities is compatible with this class of restrictions on potential treatments. translated_title: 鼓励设计的尖锐可检验含义
translated_abstract: 本文研究了一个潜在结果模型，其中结果变量为连续或离散变量，处理变量为离散多值变量，工具变量也为离散多值变量。我们针对一类对潜在处理的限制条件推导出尖锐的、闭式的可检验含义，该类限制条件要求工具变量的每个取值至多鼓励向一种唯一的处理选择；这类限制条件在近期若干著名实证论文中充当关键的识别假设。借用随机实验中的术语，我们将这种设定称为“鼓励设计”。这些可检验含义表现为以给定工具变量下处理选择和结果的条件分布所表示的不等式。通过一种新颖的构造性论证，我们证明了这些不等式是尖锐的，也就是说，任何满足这些不等式的可观测数据分布都与这类潜在处理限制条件相容。基于这些……
tldr: 本文针对“鼓励设计”（即工具变量每个取值至多鼓励向一种处理选择的潜在处理限制）推导出以条件分布不等式表示的尖锐闭式可检验含义，并通过新颖的构造性论证证明了这些不等式的尖锐性。
en_tdlr: This paper derives sharp, closed-form testable implications—expressed as inequalities on conditional distributions of choices and outcomes—for encouragement designs where each instrument value encourages at most one treatment choice, and proves their sharpness through a novel constructive argument.
